question: In which of the following Olympics was field hockey included as a sport for the first time?
solution:
The correct answer is **__1908__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Field** **Hockey **was included for the first time in the **1908 Olympics games** held in** London **along with** Football.**
 
• **India **won the **gold medal** while making its **debut in the 1928 Olympics in Amsterdam**.
 
• From **1928 to 1956 India **consecutively wins **six gold medals.**
 
• **Field Hockey:**
 
 
• **​**Number of players on each side: 11
 
• Important terms used: Penalty corner, scoop, dribble, flick, striker, center pass, etc.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Olympic games: **

 
 
• The word **'Olympic'** came from the place **'Olympia' in Greece.**
 
• It was held for the** first time in Athens, Greece in 1896.**
 
• Every year on **23rd June World Olympics Day** is celebrated.
 
• The** USA** has **hosted Olympic games for the highest 9 times** followed by **France** which has hosted **6 times** so far. 
 
• **India first time** participated in Olympics in **1900**.
